Common questions

Before you write, check these

Most messages can be answered in seconds with one of these.

How long does it take to hear back?+

We answer most messages within 1–2 business days. Bug reports and partnership inquiries are usually faster.

Can I suggest a new tool?+

Absolutely. Tool suggestions from teachers and students drive most of our roadmap — describe the task you’re trying to make easier and we’ll evaluate it.

Do you charge for any of the tools?+

No. Every tool on EduToolsHub is 100% free with no signup. If a future tool ever needs a paid tier, the existing free tools will stay free.

Is my data private when I use the tools?+

Yes. Most tools run entirely in your browser. We don’t require accounts and don’t sell user data — read the Privacy Policy for full details.
